interpretation_rules: Entitlement is based on shares at the close of record_date. Recognize dividend receivable on ex_date; make that amount spendable cash only on pay_date. Do not credit spendable cash on record/ex date.
For main-period accounts beginning 2022-04-01, no pre-start entitlement exists. Warmup actions are for adjusted signal continuity only.
Use raw traded prices for the ledger, share multiplier on effective split session, and contemporaneous cash_per_share. Do not combine fully adjusted price wealth with another cash/split credit.
Record dates from supplier split tables must not be assumed to be market ex dates. 512480 in 2021 had record 03-25, processing/suspension 03-26, resumed tradable split basis 03-29.
Splits carry no cash profit and no fee. Fractions here cannot arise from integer 100-share holdings with integer ratios.
Published cash dates model ordinary designated-trading investor receipt. Special seats/unregistered designated trading may differ; actual broker settlement is not reconstructed.
No independent tax or constituent-dividend credit is added: fund distributions described as cash per share, and constituent income/ongoing expenses already affect fund NAV.
None of the ten funds is certified as having an exhaustively reviewed official whole-life corporate-action archive. Empty tables are not proof of no events.
